attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 27, `nudK` to `yfeX`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 17% of calls. The model names 86 to 99.6% of them, fewest at column 17, `eutB`, 86%.

**A variable column breaks the spine at 28**, `pbp4b`, carried by 76%. The `eut` genes, columns 5 to 21, are [[ethanolamine utilization microcompartment]], and the `cys` genes, columns 33 to 37, are [[sulfate thiosulfate transport]]. The most plastic stretch is columns 50 to 55, variable, in a region of plasticity in 28 to 57% of calls.

**The model names about as many genes on the spine columns as on the fork and variable ones**, 94 against 92%, and hesitates less there, 0.26 against 0.33 bits. Its most hesitant column, 17, `eutB`, is a spine column, at 1.35 bits.

**The window ends on fork and variable columns.** Columns 69 to 79, `ypdE` to `yfdX`, are carried by 76 to 90% of chromosomes, all persistent.

**Across the window it names 93% of genes**, 0.28 bits on average, perplexity 1.3 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.17 against 0.21 bits, and names fewer genes, 77% against 95%.

label: nudK
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the nudK window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor nudK, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,249 to 1,328 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying nudK once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.28 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,801 calls, named 97%, 0.19 bits; shell 4,809 calls, named 71%, 0.69 bits; cloud 350 calls, named 20%, 4.03 bits. Outside an RGP 39,742 calls, named 95%, 0.21 bits; inside an RGP 3,218 calls, named 77%, 1.17 bits. Columns: 60 spine, 3 fork, 17 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.17 against 0.21 bits) and names fewer genes (77% against 95%); 3,218 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 17 (eutB, a spine column) 1.35 bits, RGP 16%; column 28 (pbp4b, a variable column) 0.74 bits, RGP 4%; column 57 (yfeD, a spine column) 0.57 bits, RGP 3%. The 3 columns (columns 51-53) where most calls are in an RGP: named 89%, 0.40 bits on average; the other 77 columns: named 94%, 0.28 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 60 spine columns: named 94%, 0.26 bits on average; the 20 fork and variable columns: named 92%, 0.33 bits. The model names about as many genes on the spine columns as on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 17, is a spine column: the model can hesitate most inside a spine.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 50-55 (variable), RGP 28-57%; the least: column 31 (variable), RGP 2%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-27 (28 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-17%. Genes: nudK, ypfG "DUF1176 domain-containing protein", tkt, tal, maeB, eutS, eutP "ethanolamine utilization acetate ki…", eutQ, eutT, pta, eutM "ethanolamine utilization microcompa…", eutN, eutE, eutJ, eutG, eutH, eutA, eutB, eutC, eutL, eutK, eutR, hemF, amiA, ypeA "GNAT family acetyltransferase", yfeZ "DUF2919 domain-containing protein", yfeY "RpoE-regulated lipoprotein", yfeX "porphyrinogen peroxidase". named 86-99.6% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 17 (eutB), named 86%, 1.35 bits.
[S2] 2. column 28 variable: share 76%, all S, RGP 4%. named 88%; 0.74 bits.
[S2.c28]    28: pbp4b S 76%
[S3] 3. columns 29-30 (2 columns) spine: share 92-95%, all P, RGP 2%. Genes: murP, murQ "N-acetylmuramic acid 6-phosphate et…". named 96-97% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 29 (murP), named 96%, 0.35 bits.
[S4] 4. column 31 variable: share 85%, all S, RGP 2%. named 98%; 0.11 bits.
[S4.c31]    31: murR S 85%
[S5] 5. columns 32-49 (18 columns) spine: share 91-95%, all P, RGP 1-17%. Genes: ucpA, cysP, cysT "sulfate/thiosulfate ABC transporter…", cysW, cysA, cysM, yfeK "YfeK family protein", pdxK, crr, ptsI "phosphoenolpyruvate-protein phospho…", ptsH, cysK "cysteine synthase A", cysZ, zipA, ligA, ypeB "DUF3820 family protein", yfeH "bile acid:sodium symporter family p…", yfeR "LysR family transcriptional regulat…". named 52-99% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 35 (cysW), named 52%; most hesitant at column 38 (yfeK), 0.43 bits.
[S6] 6. columns 50-55 (6 columns) variable: share 25-67%, all S, RGP 28-57%. named 82-91% (mean 88%), fewest named at column 50, named 82%; most hesitant at column 51, 0.48 bits.
[S6.c50-55]    columns 50-55, share 25-67%, all S: flxA 25%, yfeN "outer membrane protein OmpK" 64%, xapA 67%, xapB "xanthosine/proton symporter XapB" 63%, "DUF1427 family protein" 67%, xapR 65%
[S7] 7. columns 56-60 (5 columns) spine: share 91-95%, all P, RGP 3-7%. Genes: gltX, yfeD "MerR family transcriptional regulat…", yfeC "YfeC-like transcriptional regulator", pdeA, nupC. named 81-90% (mean 87%), fewest named at column 60 (nupC), named 81%; most hesitant at column 57 (yfeD), 0.57 bits.
[S8] 8. column 61 fork: share 49%, all S, RGP 6%. named 80%; 0.43 bits.
[S8.c61]    61: "hypothetical protein" S 49%; also "protein YpeD" S 23%
[S9] 9. columns 62-68 (7 columns) spine: share 90-94%, all P, RGP 2-7%. Genes: mntH, ypeC "DUF2502 domain-containing protein Y…", yfeO "ion channel protein", glk, fryB "PTS fructose transporter subunit IIB", fryC, ypdF "aminopeptidase". named 91-96% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 62 (mntH), named 91%, 0.57 bits.
[S10] 10. columns 69-79 (11 columns) fork and variable columns: share 76-90%, all P, RGP 2-5%. named 92-97% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 71, named 92%; most hesitant at column 70, 0.35 bits.
